# 支持 / Support

> 本项目由 **HUAT FSAC** 方程式赛车队维护。如果你遇到了问题,以下渠道可以帮到你。

## 📚 文档优先

| 场景       | 入口                                                        |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| 快速上手   | [README.md](../README.md) · [README.en.md](../README.en.md) |
| 贡献流程   | [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)                        |
| 架构与开发 | [docs/](../docs/) · [docs/WORKFLOW.md](../docs/WORKFLOW.md) |
| 部署与 CI  | [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)                 |
| 安全漏洞   | [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)(**不要**公开提 Issue)          |
| 行为准则   | [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)                  |

## 💬 提问 / 讨论

- **Bug 报告、功能请求、任务卡片**:走 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/issues/new/choose)
- **想法碰撞、问答、Show & Tell**:走 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/discussions)(如未启用可临时使用 Issue)
- **不敏感的小改动**:直接 Fork 后提 PR,详见 `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## 🛡️ 安全相关

**请勿**通过 Issue 报告安全漏洞。请使用 [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/security/advisories/new),详见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。

## 📮 联系我们

- 一般咨询 / 媒体合作:[opensrc@huat-fsac.eu.org](mailto:opensrc@huat-fsac.eu.org)
- 招募 / 加入车队:见站点 [Join Us](https://huat-fsac.eu.org/join/)
- GitHub 组织:[github.com/HUAT-FSAC](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC)

## ⏱️ 响应时间

项目由学生车队成员业余时间维护。我们会尽量在 7 天内确认收到的 Issue / Discussion,但**不承诺** SLA。如有紧急需求,请走招聘/商务渠道联系维护者。

# Support (English)

> This project is maintained by the **HUAT FSAC** Formula Student team. The
> following channels are available when you need help.

## 📚 Documentation first

| Scenario           | Entry                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Quick start        | [README.md](../README.md) · [README.en.md](../README.en.md)  |
| Contributing       | [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)                         |
| Architecture & dev | [docs/](../docs/) · [docs/WORKFLOW.md](../docs/WORKFLOW.md)  |
| Deployment & CI    | [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)                  |
| Security           | [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) — **do not** open public issues |
| Code of Conduct    | [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)                   |

## 💬 Ask / discuss

- **Bugs, features, task cards** → [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/issues/new/choose)
- **Ideas, Q&A, show & tell** → [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/discussions)
- **Small non-sensitive edits** → fork & PR, see `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## 🛡️ Security

**Do not** report security issues via public Issues. Use
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC/Guidance-Astro/security/advisories/new)
— see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

## 📮 Contact

- General / press: [opensrc@huat-fsac.eu.org](mailto:opensrc@huat-fsac.eu.org)
- Recruitment / join the team: see site [Join Us](https://huat-fsac.eu.org/join/)
- GitHub org: [github.com/HUAT-FSAC](https://github.com/HUAT-FSAC)

## ⏱️ Response time

The project is maintained by student team members in their spare time. We try
to acknowledge Issues / Discussions within 7 days, but **no SLA is promised**.
For urgent or commercial needs, contact the maintainers through recruitment /
business channels.
